title: Don't waste your money
text:
Don't waste your money. Absolute piece of junk, you "will" damage it during assembly because it is that poorly constructed, holes not drilled properly, holes not aligned properly and some of the wood is just to flimsy.
On the flip side it will burn for a good half hour.
